novelty_search.nearest_result: Direction-signed within-pair has/had and is/was contrasts do not support a stable learned task gate; the external six-cue selector does route a prospectively validated dual program.
novelty_search.new_question: Does a fixed between-pair answer-vocabulary support difference at resid:10 expose the model's task branch while temporal direction remains a separate raw-text input?

population.rows: A second 128-row matched authority: both banks share 16 new occupations disjoint from every earlier task bank; has/had uses 16 further new periods; all row IDs are new.
population.capability_first: Four base/donor forwards score all 16 native bank/family/direction cells. All must pass before task-affinity or intervention outcomes are computed or persisted.
population.capability_bars: A1/A2/P >=0.85 and C >=0.75, separately by bank and temporal direction.
population.no_rescue: No lexical replacement, row removal, feature edit, threshold fit, gain/basis/rank change, or bar change after execution.

frozen_task_gate.site: resid:10 at the intervention source's final token
frozen_task_gate.head: Checkpoint-exact RMS-normalized, 30*tanh-soft-capped unembedding logits.
frozen_task_gate.decision: has_had iff affinity > 0; is_was iff affinity < 0; exact zero is invalid. No fitted threshold or scale.
frozen_task_gate.direction: The unchanged raw-text selector supplies only temporal direction. C still takes its registered raw-text abstention path; the new internal gate is tested only on A1/A2/P.
frozen_task_gate.dispatch: Apply the predicted bank's unchanged local reader, direction-affine gain, and rank-one writer; score the true task's target/foil margin.
frozen_task_gate.conceptual_separation: Between-pair support represents task identity; within-pair signed contrast represents temporal value.

bars.routing: Task-bank accuracy >=0.75 in each of 12 bank x A1/A2/P x direction cells; no ties.
bars.causal: After affinity routing, each bank's A1/A2 recovery and P reflection have mean >=0.75 and direction fraction >=0.75.
bars.control: All 32 C rows raw-text-abstain and have exactly zero normalized effect.
bars.identity: Bases are hash-exact unit vectors; raw direction agrees on every target row; exact local/final head errors <=1e-4.
bars.price: Four forwards/256 examples, 128 rows, zero fitted scalars, grid/root/backward/update.

predictions.pred_a_authority_basis_rows_and_shared_c: All immutable hashes, fresh matched rows, bases, prior dual screen, and shared evaluation contract match.
predictions.pred_b_native_capability_first: All 16 native cells pass before outcome access.
predictions.pred_c_fixed_pair_support_task_routing: All 12 target routing cells pass 0.75 with no tie.
predictions.pred_d_affinity_dispatched_causal_preser: Both banks retain frozen A1/A2/P causal bars after predicted-bank dispatch.
predictions.pred_e_raw_text_control_abstention: All C rows abstain with exactly zero effect.
predictions.pred_f_exact_identity_coverage_and_price: Direction/head/basis identity and exact four-forward zero-fit price pass on all 128 rows.

terminal.screen: A-F pass: between-pair resid:10 support is a bounded internal task-branch read for the dual program.
terminal.null: Authority/capability/identity/price pass but routing or causal preservation misses; kill this affinity gate without threshold/feature rescue.
terminal.invalid: Authority, capability, tie, identity, coverage, finiteness, or price fails; causal outcomes remain sealed if capability fails.
